  • Method Details

    • listSigningKeys

      @RequestMapping(method=GET, value="/api/admin/keys", produces="application/json") org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<List<SigningKeyResponse>> listSigningKeys()
      GET /api/admin/keys : Lists the signing keys Never exposes private key material. Needs scope admin.
      Returns:
      The keys (status code 200) or Missing or invalid bearer token (status code 401) or The token lacks the admin scope (status code 403)

    • rotateSigningKeys

      @RequestMapping(method=POST, value="/api/admin/keys/rotate", produces="application/json") org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<List<SigningKeyResponse>> rotateSigningKeys()
      POST /api/admin/keys/rotate : Rotates the signing keys now Forces a rotation whatever the age of the active key: the active key is retired (it stays published until the tokens it signed expire), the next key becomes active and a new next key is generated. Keys retired for longer than the retention are deleted, and the published keys are refreshed. The scheduled rotation, in contrast, only rotates a key that is due. Needs scope admin.
      Returns:
      The keys after the rotation (status code 200) or Missing or invalid bearer token (status code 401) or The token lacks the admin scope (status code 403)
